title: Home workspace · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 22 Nov. One direction, with the behaviour choice drawn both ways on board 1.

A · first in every list (designer's pick): Home is first in Open Recent (own item + separator, outside the 10-item cap, Clear Menu skips it), on Welcome (own one-row group above Recent, no trash) and under each Mac in the phone menu; in a window's switcher it is a normal tile, first when open, and × / ⌫ close it from that window. Window model unchanged, cost S. Reason: the user's rule (Home is not a different kind of workspace); a tile that ignores ⌫ with its own auto-open and restore is exactly that.
B · always open in every window (not picked, drawn small on board 1): auto-open, restore and a refused close for one tile, cost M/L.

Look: the SF Symbol house, outline, muted, before the name; no pin, no badge, no accent; it stays when Home is renamed. New key ⇧⌘H Open Home (Open Recent item 1, ⌘K). Empty Home: same empty nodes as a project, one text changed per section; Agents gets 'Start a session about anything' and New session ⌘N.
